header.intro: One system: warm-neutral surfaces, terracotta accent, precise type, restrained motion. Everything below is live — switch themes, drag the sliders, press the buttons.
header.poster_caption: The system in one glance: brand color, display type, live score.

color.title: Color
color.desc: Warm paper and espresso ink in light; a true espresso theme — not an inversion — in dark. Terracotta is the single brand voice; sage, amber, and clay only ever mean status.

type.title: Typography
type.desc: Cabinet Grotesk carries names and titles. Inter does the work. JetBrains Mono speaks metadata — coordinates, hours, counts. All self-hosted, all variable where it matters.
type.display_line: Cafe names and page titles only — never body copy.
type.sans_sample: Quiet room, fast wifi, and a window seat that stays open past nine. The flat white is better than it needs to be.
type.serif_sample: A slow morning note: the espresso is bright, the corner table is free, and the rain can wait.
type.serif_line: Check-in notes and editorial surfaces only — never sheets, forms, or buttons.
type.tnum_hint: Every score, distance, and count sets with tabular figures.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.desc: One primary voice per view. Press states are felt, not seen — 120ms, a 1.5% give.

cards.title: Cards
cards.desc: Borders and tonal steps, not shadow soup. Hover lifts two pixels; the work profile is the hero — five bars, spring-loaded on entry.
cards.hover_hint: Hover and press the card — 120ms feedback, no bounce.

forms.title: Forms & sliders
forms.desc: Fields are bordered and quiet. Sliders are the heart of check-in: 0–100, live value, tabular figures, thumb swells while you drag.
forms.open_only_hint: Filters the map to cafes open at this hour

skeleton.title: Loading
skeleton.desc: Skeleton shimmer, never spinners. One light pass over the shape of what's coming.

motion.title: Motion
motion.desc: Four durations, one signature curve, springs that never bounce. Faster out than in. Nothing past 450ms. Everything yields to prefers-reduced-motion.
motion.demo_reflow: Tap a pill — the list reflows with a layout animation
motion.demo_bars: Work-profile bars spring in on entry

scoreSlider.title: Score sliders
scoreSlider.desc: Subjective 0–100 dimensions for wifi, outlets, seats, temperature, coffee, and an overall work score.

policyChips.title: Policy chips
policyChips.desc: Maximum stay policy, selectable as compact chips.

checkInSuccess.title: Check-in success
checkInSuccess.desc: A restrained bottom-card confirmation: new work score, actions, and a whisper of steam.

profilePreview.title: Profile
profilePreview.desc: Header, stats, and tabbed lists for My Cafes and My Check-ins.

searchFilter.title: Search filters
searchFilter.desc: Thumb-friendly filter surface: city, dimension minima, policies, and open-now.

searchResults.title: Unified search results
searchResults.desc: Grouped CafeMood-first results, city-center distance labels, source-gated external CTAs, and the ranking preference toggle.

themePreview.footer: CafeMood — warm paper, espresso ink, one terracotta voice · en/zh via next-intl

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.collect_body: Your account (email, display name), the check-ins and cafes you create, and — only when you grant it — your location to center the map. We collect nothing else.
privacy.use_body: Your data powers the map, your profile, and cafe rankings. We never sell it, never show ads, and never share it with third parties beyond the infrastructure that runs the app (hosting, database, maps).
privacy.location_body: Location permission is used only to center the map and mark your position. A denied or revoked grant never blocks the app — you can always pick a city manually.
privacy.share_body: Check-ins and cafes you mark public are visible to everyone. Private entries stay visible only to you.
privacy.retention_body: Deleting your account removes your check-ins and profile. Cafes you created are kept under the CafeMood system account so the community keeps the data.
privacy.contact_body: Questions about your data? Reach us through the GitHub repository linked from About.

terms.title: Terms
terms.service_body: CafeMood is a free, non-commercial community map of specialty coffee shops. It is provided as-is, without warranties of any kind.
terms.content_body: You keep ownership of what you post. By publishing a cafe or check-in you grant CafeMood a license to display it inside the app. Deleted accounts transfer their cafes to the system account.
terms.accuracy_body: Cafe details, scores, and hours come from the community and public sources. We do not guarantee they are correct — check before you travel.
terms.conduct_body: Do not post false information, spam, or content you do not have the right to share. We may remove content and accounts that abuse the service.
terms.changes_body: We may update these terms as the app evolves. Continued use after a change means you accept the new terms.
terms.contact_body: Questions about these terms? Reach us through the GitHub repository linked from About.

about.title: About
about.mission_body: CafeMood exists to answer one question well: where is the good coffee? A quiet, fast map of specialty cafes — no ads, no feeds, no noise.
about.principles_body: Value first, zero commercial hostility, minimal cognitive overhead, and craft in every pixel. The app is free and stays that way.
about.craft_body: Built by people who care about coffee and software. Scores come from real check-ins, not sponsored placements.
about.version_body: CafeMood {version} — a work in progress, improved continuously.
